<b>Throwing Ring</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It acts as a ricocheting throwable weapon.

== Usefulness ==
Throwing Ring is best used in small enclosed spaces with many [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] or one large enemy. Its ability to bounce between enemies allows it to efficiently clean up smaller groups of foes, and its ability to bounce off surfaces can allows it to deal damage multiple times to larger enemies in smaller rooms.

== How to Acquire ==
Given to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] by [[Shakra]] after finishing the <i>[[Trail's End]]</i> [[Wish]].

== Trivia ==
* When the Throwing Ring is equipped and has at least two uses left, Hornet's usual [[Challenge]] animation will be replaced with Hornet clanging the Throwing Rings together and saying "Poshanka!", similar in manner to [[Shakra]]'s greeting. 
** This variant of Challenge costs no [[Silk]] (as opposed to taking 1 strand) and will not increase [[Needle]] damage; instead, it increases the damage of the next use of Throwing Ring by 50%.
** When used next to [[Shakra]], she will respond with "Poshanka!" as well.
** Additionally, if used next to one of Shakra's calling rings, it will summon her as if it was struck.
* This tool and the [[Snare Setter]] are the only two tools required for [[Sister of the Void]] Ending.
